draft.subject: Acme's order system move | a thought on the cloud
draft.body:
Hi Maria,

Saw that Acme Retail is replacing its on-premise order system this year, so I thought our cloud migration work might connect with your plans.

InfoBeans plans and runs the move of applications and data to the cloud.

Would you be open to a short conversation next week to compare notes?

Best,
[sender]

note: A plain request to cut the length must not add anything new.
